headline: Going Commando's USA v1.01 progress report rises from 97.38% to 98.83% of code
summary: Going Commando's refreshed progress report puts USA v1.01 at 98.83% of code, up from 97.38%, with 8,491 of 8,527 functions matched. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The refresh counts matches from November 8 and 9 and precedes the day's final PAL matching pull request (#437).
highlights: The same refresh puts the PAL release at 96.60% of code, up from 95.57%, with 8,526 of 8,607 functions matched.
USA v2.00 reaches 97.53% of code in the refresh, up from 96.17%, with 8,515 of 8,579 functions matched.
The day's matching work includes HUD panels and functions across several levels.
Four more PAL functions landed in #437, with three near misses retained separately from matched code.
Readable names for 105 functions were added using their Ratchet & Clank counterparts (#438).
#439 closed without merging. Its seven proposed USA v1.01 functions already have C implementations on master, and the author reports conflicts with the current branch.
